author: McFanta_
body:
Trinux a TDM Map by McFanta_

Hi this is my very first map ever on The Avicus Network! The map is a team death match nether themed style! The map may not be the best but I like it though. It took some few days to build it reasons why it took a while it's because I have school . The map has mostly been built by worldedit so hopefully the map is bug free. One thing that kinda suck is I can't be on testing because I am banned of course but still I will make maps for Avicus. Have fun testing my map!

Thanks Jiveh! For fixing the yml!


Update Logs

I have updated the html to a brand new better looking style!
Thanks again to Jiveh! For fixing the yml. I have submitted my map hype! View my status here :D: https://trello.com/c/YEK9jtan/142-tdm-trinux-1-1-by-mcfanta
Also new packaged download link with yml and map.png!
